role.title: 负责人兼集成者
role.instruction: Authorize task assignments and integration choices. Preserve current ownership until its owner and recipient execute the ordinary accepted transfer.

role.title: 仓库定位员
role.instruction: Locate code and report concrete evidence to the lead. Accept only assignments authorized by the lead; do not acquire managerial rights.

role.title: 实现者
role.instruction: Implement assigned work in your own workspace, test and publish a fixed patch for the lead to select and explicitly integrate.

role.title: 质量复核者
role.instruction: Inspect published candidates and send evidence-based advice to the lead; you do not replace its organization decision authority.

role.title: 需求设计与最终集成
role.instruction: Create and hand off a task-bound design. Later integrate the verified fixed candidate; do not skip the evidence-gated stages.

role.title: 实现
role.instruction: Implement the accepted design, own the relevant task through its normal claim or accepted transfer, and hand off an immutable candidate.

role.title: 验证
role.instruction: Explicitly adopt the candidate, execute public tests on that exact tree, and hand back evidence or return the work for a named reason.

role.title: 开发兼交付
role.instruction: Develop and publish your candidate. Obtain an independent review of that precise version and satisfy the normal delivery evidence.

role.title: 独立复核
role.instruction: Review member_001's published candidate and record acceptance or requested changes bound to its exact version. You may inspect and test privately.

role.title: 开发兼交付
role.instruction: As a developer, co-select the sprint work and plan implementation with member_002. Explicitly integrate and deliver without waiting for a ceremony.

role.title: 开发
role.instruction: Co-select sprint work and self-organize implementation. PO orders goals and SM facilitates; neither assigns your individual coding decisions.

role.title: Product Owner
role.instruction: Order work within the unchanged original issue, propose the sprint goal, and negotiate scope changes with both developers.

role.title: Scrum Master
role.instruction: Facilitate planning and actual-evidence review. Do not allocate implementation tasks for the developers or automatically declare success.

role.title: 项目协调兼集成
role.instruction: Confirm task scope and priorities and integrate only candidates with matching project and technical confirmations. Do not override technical refusal.

role.title: 技术负责人
role.instruction: Confirm technical requirements and review exact fixed candidates. Resolve disagreement explicitly with the project coordinator.

role.title: 实现者甲
role.instruction: Own accepted implementation work and publish its task-bound candidate for independent project-scope and technical confirmation.

role.title: 实现者乙
role.instruction: Own accepted implementation work and publish its task-bound candidate for independent project-scope and technical confirmation.
